FM04.reasoning: The agent computes the median on the full training DataFrame before splitting it into training and validation sets, causing minor data leakage from validation into training.

FM14.reasoning: The agent trains a single LightGBM model with stochastic subsampling parameters without averaging predictions over multiple random seeds.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission IDs using an integer sequence starting from 0 instead of using the original IDs from the test set. This will cause the submission to fail evaluation if the test IDs do not start at 0.

summary: The agent correctly frames the time-series forecasting problem by adding date features and using a time-based split to find optimal early-stopping iterations. However, it leaks validation statistics during median imputation and critically fails to use the correct test IDs for the final submission, instead hardcoding a sequence starting from 0.
